name: Prof Jeffrey Zajac
title: Prof / Endocrinologist
description: Endocrinologist (former Director of Endocrinology at Austin Health) whose specialities include Transgender and Intersex Health; the practice provides masculinising and feminising hormone therapy for trans people. Listed in the AusPATH Victorian provider directory. All appointments require a referral from a GP or specialist. Also consults at the Vermont South clinic (Level 3, Suite 2, 645 Burwood Highway).
specialties: Transgender and intersex health, diabetes, thyroid, adrenal, pituitary, men's health, bone

name: Dr Nicholas Russell
title: Dr / Endocrinologist & General Physician
description: Endocrinologist who 'invites referrals in all aspects of Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism, including in obesity management and transgender care'. Listed in the AusPATH Victorian provider directory. Referral from GP or specialist required. Preston Medical Specialists offers telehealth.
specialties: Transgender care, endocrinology, diabetes, metabolism, obesity, general medicine

name: Dr Sylvia Xu
title: Dr / Endocrinologist
address: Consulting Suite 2, Ground Floor, Epworth Camberwell Hospital, 888 Toorak Road
description: Endocrinologist who welcomes referrals in all areas of endocrinology including transgender medicine; described as seeking 'to be inclusive and holistic in the care of her patients'. Listed in the AusPATH Victorian provider directory. Specialist referral from GP required (Healthlink ID baldurhl). Fluent in Mandarin.
specialties: Transgender medicine, women's health, diabetes, PCOS, thyroid, pituitary, osteoporosis

name: Dr Ailie Connell
title: Dr / Endocrinologist & Chemical Pathologist
description: Endocrinologist listed in the AusPATH (Australian Professional Association for Trans Health) Victorian provider directory; her Epworth profile notes an interest in transgender health. Private rooms at Blackburn Specialist Centre; appointments at Epworth Eastern and Eastern Health (Box Hill). Specialist referral from GP required.
specialties: Transgender health, diabetes, pituitary, thyroid, obstetric endocrinology, perioperative medicine

name: Mark Thompson
title: Nurse (MNP, GCertSRH)
practice: Thorne Harbour Health - Equinox Trans & Gender Diverse Clinic
description: Nurse (Master of Nurse Practitioner, Grad Cert Sexual & Reproductive Health) listed in the AusPATH Victorian provider directory under Thorne Harbour Health's trans and gender diverse health service. Equinox is a general practice clinic specifically for trans and gender diverse people offering gender-affirming primary care; its waitlist reopened in Feb 2026 with limited places.
specialties: Trans and gender diverse health, sexual and reproductive health

name: Dr Michele O'Connell
title: Dr / Paediatric Endocrinologist
description: Paediatrician (FRACP, MD) at The Royal Children's Hospital listed under Paediatrics in the AusPATH Victorian trans health provider directory. The RCH Gender Service prescribes puberty suppression and gender-affirming hormones (oestrogen, testosterone) via its paediatricians and paediatric endocrinologists. New referrals accepted up to the 16th birthday; referral from a GP or paediatrician required.
specialties: Paediatric endocrinology, puberty suppression, gender-affirming hormones

name: Dr Shaamini Lokuge-Hayes
title: Dr / Paediatrician
description: Paediatrician (FRACP) at The Royal Children's Hospital listed under Paediatrics in the AusPATH Victorian trans health provider directory. The RCH Gender Service prescribes puberty suppression and gender-affirming hormones for trans and gender diverse young people; new referrals accepted up to age 16 with a GP or paediatrician referral.
specialties: Paediatrics, trans and gender diverse youth health
